artworks.title: Hercules Obtaining the Girdle of Hippolyta
artworks.description: This small oil panel by the German-born Dutch painter Nikolaus Knüpfer stages the climax of Heracles' ninth labour: the hero confronting Hippolyta, queen of the Amazons, to win the war-belt of Ares she wore in token of her supremacy. Knüpfer renders the encounter as a turbulent baroque drama of armed warriors and rearing horses, evoking the moment Apollodorus describes when Hera, disguised as an Amazon, spread the rumor that the strangers were abducting the queen, turning a promised peaceful handover into bloodshed. The painting is held in the Hermitage Museum, Saint Petersburg.

artworks.title: Hercule saisissant Hippolyte, reine des Amazones (Hercules Seizing Hippolyta, Queen of the Amazons)
artworks.description: In this preparatory drawing the French Neoclassical master Ingres distills the violent core of the labour into pure line: Heracles overpowering the Amazon queen Hippolyta to seize the belt of Ares. Ingres, a lifelong student of antique heroic subjects, captures the wrestling tension of the two figures with the disciplined contour for which his draftsmanship is celebrated. The sheet is preserved in the Musée Ingres Bourdelle in Montauban.

artworks.title: Hunting Amazons (Roman mosaic with Hippolyte, Melanippe, Penthesileia and Thermodosa)
artworks.description: A late-antique Roman floor mosaic depicting four named Amazons at the hunt — Melanippe and Penthesileia mounted on horseback while Hippolyte and Thermodosa pursue game on foot — set amid wild animals and Eros figures in the border. The labelled figure of Hippolyte preserves the ancient image of the belt-bearing queen of the Amazons in the medium of monumental decoration, showing how her legend persisted in domestic art centuries after the classical vase tradition.

films.title: Wonder Woman
films.description: Connie Nielsen's Hippolyta is queen of Themyscira and Diana's mother — the Amazon who hid the Godkiller and still lets her daughter leave the island.

films.title: Wonder Woman 1984
films.description: Nielsen's Hippolyta returns in flashback as the mother who trained Diana on Themyscira — the Amazon queen behind Wonder Woman's origin.

films.title: Justice League
films.description: Hippolyta guards a Mother Box on Themyscira and warns Diana when Steppenwolf comes — the Amazon queen as first line against the New Gods' war.

films.title: Wonder Woman
films.description: The Lynda Carter series keeps Hippolyta as the island queen who sends Diana into Man's World — the mythic mother behind the lasso and the invisible jet.

music.title: By Jupiter
music.description: Rodgers and Hart's last Broadway musical, after The Warrior's Husband, puts Hippolyta's Amazons on stage — the queen's realm invaded by Greek men in comic reverse.

popCulture.title: Wonder Woman Historia: The Amazons
popCulture.creator: Kelly Sue DeConnick
popCulture.description: DeConnick's Black Label epic rebuilds Amazon origins with Hippolyta at the centre — the queen forged in Hera's rage and the mother of Wonder Woman's people.

popCulture.title: Hippolyta
popCulture.creator: William Moulton Marston
popCulture.description: Marston and H. G. Peter's Golden Age queen is Diana's mother from All Star Comics onward — the mythic Hippolyta reborn as Paradise Island's immortal ruler.

popCulture.title: Wonder Woman
popCulture.creator: William Moulton Marston
popCulture.description: The ongoing Wonder Woman title keeps Hippolyta as Amazon queen and Diana's mother — the mythic belt-bearer rewritten as the source of the lasso's world.

popCulture.title: The Warrior's Husband
popCulture.creator: Julian F. Thompson
popCulture.description: Thompson's Broadway comedy flips the Amazon war: Hippolyta's women-ruled Pontus meets Greek invaders — the source play behind Rodgers and Hart's By Jupiter.
